entries.title: What the Ten Gods are
entries.content: The Ten Gods describe how every other part of a chart relates to your Day Master. They group into five themes: support, peers, expression, wealth and authority.
entries.source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Luck Pillars (dayun)
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Direct vs indirect wealth
entries.content: Direct wealth is read as steady, planned earning. Indirect wealth is read as risk, sudden chances and ventures.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Hurting Officer
entries.content: The Hurting Officer is read as strong creativity and self-expression, sometimes pushing against authority. It is often linked with independent or artistic paths.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
